newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ethiopian birr weakens against the dollar.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopian birr weakens against the dollar.

text.p: The Ethiopian birr was marginally weaker against the dollar on Monday, the central National Bank of Ethiopia (NBE) said.
It posted the birr at a mean rate of 6.436 against the dollar compared to 6.426 last week.

Against the pound, the birr was posted at a mean rate of 10.9392 from 10.9640; against the yen, the birr was traded at 0.055660 from 0.055363 previously and against the mark, the birr was traded at 4.1597 from 4.1541 last week.
